A clamped paragraph keeps exactly two visible lines and paints its custom continuation marker after the final visible content.
Justified text expands ordinary lines while the final line uses its independently centered alignment.
“Initial letters” occupy three line heights, sink through two lines, and leave later lines at the normal measure.
“Opening and closing punctuation can hang outside the measure.”
Text box trimming removes the outer half-leading while preserving the inline content metrics.
